# 💬 Cordi

**Stay connected to Eorzea, even when you're AFK.**

Cordi acts as a powerful bridge between **Final Fantasy XIV** and **Discord**, giving you full control remotely.

### ✨ Features
* 📤 **Chat Relay:** Stream your in-game chat log to Discord in real-time.
* 📥 **Remote Reply:** Send messages from Discord directly into the game chat.
* 👀 **Peeper:** Get notified when someone looks at you in-game—and **look back at them** directly through Discord!
* 👋 **Interaction:** See when someone emotes at you and emote back without being at your PC.
* 🕵️ **Party Intel:** Track when members join, leave, or when the party fills. (Plus, get some immediate "insights" about them 😏)
* 🚀 **And much more:** Explore a wide range of additional features designed to make your life easier.

---

[**👉 Click here for the Setup Guide**](https://github.com/Nyakaze/Cordi/wiki/Setup-Guide)
